purpose: Shared non-secret settings for the Stardust tools project and the knarr host outline. No credentials, keys, IPs, or secret paths.

stardust.description: CLI control plane for Backdrop CMS. Tools repo, not a site.

www-admin.note: File group only. Extra login only with installer -a NAME when NAME != GROUP. Do not create a www-admin user.

deploy.note: Git/deploy identity. Not an interactive admin. New hosts use HOME /srv/stardust/home.

www-data.note: Apache/PHP worker. Not the sole owner of /srv/apps/*.

sd.note: Temporary VM operator on knarr. Groups only. Installer must not add group sudo.

platform.name: host
platform.role: Base host layout, groups, and paths

platform.name: dnsmasq
platform.role: Local resolver; wildcards for *.devel and *.knarr; STEP 25

platform.name: deploy
platform.role: System deploy account and sudoers for stardust-priv / bee / git / crdir

platform.name: bee
platform.role: Backdrop CLI; stardust bee PLATFORM PRODUCT

runtime.name: core
runtime.role: Shared core helpers; not an install phase

runtime.name: site
runtime.role: stardust site-* verbs for Backdrop sites

runtime.name: migrate-d7
runtime.role: Drupal 7 / BOA to Backdrop migration helpers

runtime.name: ui
runtime.role: Optional TUI; not required on host

product.name: nextcloud
product.note: First product app under the apps contract. Lives in a separate NxtCldInst repo today. Not installed by install-stardust.sh. Not a Backdrop site.

contracts.backdrop_sites: Use stardust site-* under /srv/platforms. Do not treat product apps as sites.
contracts.product_apps: Use stardust apps install|align|status|remove|doctor NAME once the contract lands. Code and data live under /srv/apps, not /srv/platforms.
contracts.install_stardust: install-stardust.sh installs platform apps from MANIFEST only. It must not install product apps.
contracts.dns_vhosts: Name-based Apache *:80. No loopback pins in /etc/hosts for *.knarr or *.devel.
contracts.identity: Product and platform apps inherit roles.www-admin / deploy / stardust / www-data. No new sudo group. No www-admin login user.
